uncovered_shapes.sentence: Haberl and colleagues published a 2020 report weighing more than 800 studies.

claims.claim: Mary Peltola won Alaska's Senate seat with 50.1 percent of first-choice votes to Dan Sullivan's 45.8 percent, with about 99 percent counted.
claims.episode_span: with The Associated Press count at 50.1 percent of first-choice votes to Sullivan’s 45.8 percent and an estimated 99 percent of votes counted
claims.source_title: Why Democrat Mary Peltola’s US Senate win in Alaska matters
claims.supporting_quote: As of early Wednesday, The Associated Press news agency’s count gave her 50.1 percent of first-choice votes against Sullivan’s 45.8 percent, with an estimated 99 percent of votes counted.

claims.claim: Peltola's win brings Democratic Senate control to 56 seats against the Republicans' 44.
claims.episode_span: her win gives Democrats 56 seats to the Republicans’ 44
claims.source_title: Why Democrat Mary Peltola’s US Senate win in Alaska matters
claims.supporting_quote: Peltola’s win brings Democratic control of the Senate to 56 seats, against the Republicans’ 44.

claims.claim: The BBC reported that confirmation of Mary Peltola's victory caps the Democrats' rout in the midterm Senate election.
claims.episode_span: confirmation of her victory caps the Democrats’ rout of Republicans in the midterm Senate election
claims.source_title: Democrats win Alaska Senate race two weeks after midterms counting began
claims.supporting_quote: Confirmation of Mary Peltola's victory caps of the party's rout of the Republicans in the midterms Senate election.

claims.claim: The Alaska Supreme Court on June 29 upheld a ruling that Daniel J. Sullivan was eligible for the ballot.
claims.episode_span: the Alaska Supreme Court upheld that on June 29
claims.source_title: Why Democrat Mary Peltola’s US Senate win in Alaska matters
claims.supporting_quote: A superior court judge ruled he was eligible, and the Alaska Supreme Court upheld that ruling on June 29.

claims.claim: President Trump arrived in Shenzhen for APEC talks Thursday with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin.
claims.episode_span: President Donald Trump has landed in Shenzhen for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation, or APEC, summit
claims.source_title: Trump lands in China for historic meeting with Xi, Putin
claims.supporting_quote: President Donald Trump has arrived in Shenzhen for the APEC summit ahead of historic trilateral talks Thursday with Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

claims.claim: Xi Jinping greeted Trump on the tarmac in Shenzhen, reciprocating a September gesture in Washington.
claims.episode_span: Xi greeted Trump on the tarmac, returning a gesture Trump made when Xi visited Washington in September
claims.source_title: Trump lands in China with key meetings with Xi and Putin on the agenda
claims.supporting_quote: Xi paid Trump a special honor by greeting him on the tarmac after Air Force One arrived in Shenzhen, reciprocating a gesture made by the U.S. president during Xi's visit to Washington in September.

claims.claim: Xi called for partnerships on scientific innovation, the digital economy, artificial intelligence, and a green transition.
claims.episode_span: We should actively build partnerships for scientific and technological innovation
claims.source_title: Trump lands in China for historic meeting with Xi, Putin
claims.supporting_quote: He said: "We should actively build partnerships for scientific and technological innovation, deepen cooperation in the digital economy and artificial intelligence and promote a green and low-carbon transition."

claims.claim: Elbridge Colby said Ukraine's deep strikes have not ended the war or blunted Russia's front-line advances.
claims.episode_span: those deep strikes have not driven an end to the war or blunted Russia’s front-line advances
claims.source_title: Ukraine allies reject U.S. criticism of deep strikes inside Russia ahead of Trump-Putin-Xi summit
claims.supporting_quote: U.S. Undersecretary of Defense Elbridge Colby likened Ukraine's deep strikes inside Russia to a spectacle, adding that they "have not been effective in driving an end to the war, nor do they contribute to blunting Russia's advances on the front line."

claims.claim: Boris Pistorius called criticism of Ukrainian strikes on strategic military targets quite stupid and described Russian strikes on civilian infrastructure as terrorism.
claims.episode_span: criticizing strikes meant to destroy strategic military and military-use targets “is quite a stupid thing, I think,”
claims.source_title: Ukraine allies reject U.S. criticism of deep strikes inside Russia ahead of Trump-Putin-Xi summit
claims.supporting_quote: German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius said criticizing strikes designed to destroy strategic military and military-use targets in Russia "is quite a stupid thing, I think."

claims.claim: The European Commission proposed a 45 billion euro loan to Ukraine for 2027 to cover about two-thirds of Kyiv's financing needs, to be repaid from Russian reparations.
claims.episode_span: proposed a €45 billion loan to Ukraine for 2027, France24 reports, to help cover around two-thirds of Kyiv’s financing needs
claims.source_title: EU proposes new €45 billion Ukraine loan to be repaid by Russia
claims.supporting_quote: European Commission President Ursula von ⁠der Leyen announced on Wednesday a proposed €45 billion loan to Ukraine for 2027 to help cover around two-thirds ​of Kyiv's financing ​needs.

claims.claim: Bukele has sent more than 2,000 troops to Haiti since late October, and the UN recorded 4,595 killings and 2,050 injuries from armed violence in the first 10 months of this year.
claims.episode_span: Bukele has sent more than 2,000 troops since late October
claims.source_title: Photos: Thousands march in Haiti in support of Salvadoran troops
claims.supporting_quote: Bukele has sent more than 2,000 troops to Haiti since late October, after four soldiers from El Salvador went missing during an operation by the United Nations-backed Gang Suppression Force (GSF).

claims.claim: UK CPI inflation was 3.6 percent in October, up from 3.5 percent in September.
claims.episode_span: inflation rose to a 12-month high of 3.6 percent in October, up from 3.5 percent in September
claims.source_title: UK inflation hits 12-month high of 3.6% on soaring fuel, tobacco costs
claims.supporting_quote: The rate of Consumer Prices Index (CPI) inflation was 3.6 per cent in October, up from 3.5 per cent in September, the Office for National Statistics (ONS) said on Wednesday.

claims.claim: Arsenic in Mae Sai waterworks was 30 times the safe limit, and Sai River water was 25 times the drinking-water limit.
claims.episode_span: arsenic in the local waterworks tested at 30 times the safe limit
claims.source_title: Myanmar-linked arsenic pollution prompts clean water scramble in Thailand
claims.supporting_quote: Tap water supplies to thousands of homes in 14 villages in Mae Sai district near the Myanmar border were suspended this month after officials found arsenic levels in the local waterworks to be 30 times over the safe limit.

claims.claim: Rio Tinto will pay 250 million dollars to address environmental damage and human rights problems from a long-closed Papua New Guinea mine.
claims.episode_span: Rio Tinto will pay $250 million to address environmental damage from its long-closed mine in Papua New Guinea
claims.source_title: Rio Tinto to Pay $250 Million to Address Mine’s Environmental Damage
claims.supporting_quote: The landmark deal will also go toward remedying human rights problems caused by the long-closed Papua New Guinea mine.

claims.claim: The EU economy has grown by more than 70 percent since 1990 while carbon emissions have dropped by around 40 percent.
claims.episode_span: the economy has grown by more than 70 percent since 1990 while carbon emissions have dropped by around 40 percent
claims.source_title: How a green economy could help reverse climate change
claims.supporting_quote: In the European Union , the bloc-wide economy has grown by more than 70% since 1990. Meanwhile, the EU's carbon emissions have dropped by around 40%.

claims.claim: The New York Times reports Trump halted some sanctions on Russia and announced the United States will buy Russian diesel, and that intelligence says Putin will continue the Ukraine war.
claims.episode_span: Trump has halted some sanctions on Russia and announced that the United States will buy Russian diesel
claims.source_title: Putin Will Continue Ukraine War Despite Plans to Meet Trump, Intelligence Says
claims.supporting_quote: He has halted some sanctions on Russia and announced that the United States will buy Russian diesel.
